digest.component_or_area: bridge CLI / reconciler engine / entrypoint facades
propositions: Bridge preview/sync must become the primary CLI vocabulary while legacy reconcile entrypoints remain callable with their documented defaults and behavior unchanged

Legacy --mode and --filter-local-ids flags must retain their semantics: --mode controls live/dry-run defaults and gate values; --filter-local-ids filters writes after full differ examination; canonical --only/--except narrow differ inputs before differs run
Every --only/--except token must resolve to an existing local ID or Jira key before lock acquisition; unresolvable input must exit 2 without lock, sync, fetch, or mutation
Targets that disappear between preflight resolution and the locked load must exit 2, name the missing IDs, release the lock, and invoke no differ, applier, manifest, or persistence seam
bridge sync --max-changes N must apply deterministic N-element partitions with applied/deferred manifests retained for capped runs; uncapped live must delete its temporary manifest as before

Direct-engine legacy calls with --mode and argument-less python -m rebar_reconciler must route through the same normalized core as canonical preview/sync while preserving their distinct defaults; library reconcile() and MCP reconcile tool must remain registered with historical dry-run and gate behavior
